ImageDescription.value: Memorial to the victims of Soviet political repressions in the city of Donetsk, eastern Ukraine. Rutchenkove field. In 1989, the graves of 500 people with bullet-damaged skulls were found at this site. A memorial plaque was installed in 2004, and a monument in 2005. In 2016, the monument was dismantled by the Donetsk People's Republic government
